description: Lost Horizons is a FaML science fantasy mod that defines technological and arcane developments into interstellar exploration and hybrid constructs using two energy systems, three tech trees, and unconventional materials.

mods.name: Lost Horizons
mods.description: Lost Horizons is a science fiction/fantasy mod that bridges the scientific and the arcane in a whole new perspective.
